why_a_new_protocol: The F-R1 F2b trigger used a mis-scaled denominator, so |zma|>=2 selected ~3.6-sigma outliers instead of 2-sigma. This is a NEW pre-registered protocol with the corrected standardisation; F-R1 itself is NOT edited and its verdict stands.

bounds.thresholds_declared_a_priori: one cut (|z|>=2) plus the pre-flight calibration assertions below

data.bars: 1m bars per segment; a bar is usable at its close ts (PIT)

corrected_definition.K_n_derivation: D_t = close_t - SMA_n = (1/n) * sum_{k=1..n-1} (close_t - close_{t-k}); for iid increments with per-bar price variance s_p^2, Cov(close_t-close_{t-k}, close_t-close_{t-l}) = min(k,l) s_p^2, so Var(D) = [sum_{k,l=1..n-1} min(k,l) / n^2] s_p^2 = [(n-1)(2n-1)/(6n)] s_p^2, giving std(D) = s_p * K_n.
corrected_definition.sigma_ret_20: trailing 20-bar std of 1-bar returns, shifted by 1 bar (causal)
corrected_definition.units: numerator is price; denominator is close (price) x dimensionless return-sigma x dimensionless K => the ratio is dimensionless. Units were already consistent in F-R1; ONLY the scale constant was wrong.
corrected_definition.frozen_definition_for_comparison: F-R1 used K = sqrt(20) = 4.472136, i.e. the denominator was 1.799685x too wide (80.0% too wide).
limits: assumes locally iid, zero-drift increments and a constant sigma across the 20-bar window
sigma is estimated from returns but applied to a price-scale deviation; a Student-t style adjustment for the sigma-estimation error is NOT included (kept simple and pre-registered)

pre_flight_assertions.A1_synthetic_scale: on 200k iid Gaussian returns, std(zma) must land in [0.95, 1.08]; measured 1.0445 (PASS). The F-R1 scale gives 0.5804 (FAIL) - this assertion would have caught the defect.
pre_flight_assertions.A2_synthetic_rate: on the same synthetic series, P(|zma|>=2) must land in [4.0%, 6.5%]; measured 5.619% (PASS); the F-R1 scale gives 0.126% (FAIL).
pre_flight_assertions.A3_real_rate_reported: the realised trigger rate on the snapshot must be reported next to the theoretical rate BEFORE any edge verdict. Measured (corrected): 5.1567% = 2374/46037; theoretical Gaussian 4.55%; fat-tail inflation vs Gaussian ~1.13x (synthetic-with-rolling-sigma) to ~1.13x.
pre_flight_assertions.A4_no_silent_rescale: if A1/A2 fail, the run aborts and reports; no threshold may be re-tuned to make them pass.

hypotheses.statement: a price that sits >= 2 corrected sigma away from its 20-bar mean reverts toward that mean
hypotheses.entry: first tick with ts > the trigger bar's close ts; at ask (long) / bid (short)
hypotheses.exit: mid at the first tick with ts >= entry_ts + h

hypotheses.statement: the mirror control: the same trigger followed in the direction of the deviation

validation.train_test_isolation: time-ordered 70/30 by event time; no shuffle
validation.oos: final 30% of event time reported separately
validation.bootstrap: block bootstrap over events, n=2000, 50 blocks
validation.overlap_check: raw n, overlap ratio, effective_n = greedy non-overlapping count; floor 30
robustness: sign stability IS vs OOS and across sub-segments
validation.VALIDATED_EDGE_requires: cost-adjusted positive on IS AND OOS at 1x, permutation p<0.05, bootstrap CI excluding 0, effective_n>=30, sign stable across sub-segments, survives 2x cost, AND A1-A4 all PASS

before_fix_theory.note: rolling-sigma noise + fat tails make the tail ~7x fatter than the normal table

after_fix_measured_distribution_only.note: distribution-only measurement; no forward returns computed

after_fix_expected_effective_n_at_5m.derivation: 2374 raw events x the 0.673 overlap-efficiency observed in F-R1 at 5m (68/101); the refractory approximation N*p/(1+(h-1)p) gives 1968 raw-adjacent, x0.673 = 1325 - consistent
after_fix_expected_effective_n_at_5m.note: EXPECTATION only; to be measured in the run. Comfortably above the effective_n floor of 30 either way.

verified_by: synthetic iid Gaussian (std 0.5804 vs 1.0445, ratio 0.5557 = 1/1.799685 exactly)

run_order: A1 -> A2 -> A3 -> A4 -> (only if all PASS) return validation; A1 or A2 FAIL => STATUS=PROTOCOL_VALIDATION_FAILED and STOP

verdict_rule.VALIDATED_EDGE: A1-A4 PASS AND cost-adjusted positive on IS AND OOS at 1x AND permutation p<0.05 AND bootstrap CI excludes 0 AND effective_n>=30 AND not dependent on a single session or a single volatility tercile AND the FADE direction has independent evidence
verdict_rule.DATA_BLOCKED: the data or protocol cannot complete the validation
verdict_rule.PROTOCOL_VALIDATION_FAILED: A1 or A2 FAIL (pre-flight abort; no return is computed)

fdr.family: all R2 directional tests (2 directions x 5 horizons = 10 permutation p-values)
